description: The genre HUD view-model (P9a.core; catalog genre-hud-layouts): a genre's uiLayout and show* flags → which base HUD parts show (chrome) and the genre's own elements, in reading order, with text and tone (a colour role) formatted by the model. Moved from Babylon's genre-hud-model.ts, plus a fighting layout (a genre seen through the fighting camera, or fighting in the fighting style). Runner: src/ui/genre-hud-corpus.ts. Ops: config {genre} → genreHudConfigOf(the registry entry); view {config, state?} → genreHudView; genre_view {genre, state?} → the view of that genre's own config. Refusals {ok:false, refusal:{code, field}}: unknown_genre, unknown_layout. Compare exactly, object key sets included. Regenerate with npm run genre-hud-corpus; npm run genre-hud-corpus:check fails on any difference. See docs/game-genres.md §6.

contract.fightingRule: layout is 'fighting' when cameraMode is 'fighting' or combatStyle is 'fighting'; else uiLayout
contract.chromeRule: each base HUD part shows exactly when its show* flag is true
contract.fpsRule: showAmmoCounter and showCompass hide their elements only when false (absent shows them, as Babylon did)
contract.ammoToneRule: reloading: warning; current <= floor(magazine * 0.25): danger; else text_primary
contract.headingRule: heading wrapped into [0, 360), printed rounded (360 prints 0); point = compassCardinal
